title: Shopify Store Products Scraper
description: Extract public product catalog data from Shopify storefronts you own, administer, or have permission to monitor. The default uses Shopify's official Mock.Shop demo.

storeUrls.title: Shopify Store URLs / Domains
storeUrls.description: List of Shopify storefront domains or HTTPS URLs. The default is Shopify's official Mock.Shop demo.

maxProductsPerStore.title: Max Products Per Store
maxProductsPerStore.description: Maximum number of products to scrape per store. The default is 1 for a low-cost first run.

productType.title: Filter by Product Type
productType.description: Only keep products whose product type matches this exactly (case-insensitive). Leave empty for all.

confirmAuthorizedUse.title: I am authorized to monitor these stores
confirmAuthorizedUse.description: Required for any real store. Confirm that you own, administer, or have permission to monitor each supplied storefront. Not required for the official demo.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Leave proxy off for the official demo and normal public storefront access. A proxy does not override store permissions, robots.txt, or access restrictions.
